about_the_game:
Embark on an epic journey in Kathana: The Coming of the Dark Ages and immerse yourself in a world brimming with adventure!

Join forces with friends and connect with adventurers from around the globe in this captivating classic MMO. Set out on shared quests, overcome formidable challenges, and experience everything Kathana has to offer.

Key Features:

  • Rich, Immersive Storyline: Uncover the mysteries of Kathana through a deep and engaging narrative.

  • Solo and Party Quests: Tackle quests alone or team up with others for greater rewards.

  • Epic Boss Hunts: Face off against powerful bosses in thrilling encounters.

  • Dangerous Dungeons: Explore perilous dungeons filled with secrets and treasures.

  • Guild Wars: Battle for dominance and glory in large-scale guild conflicts.

  • Ranked PvP Arenas: Test your skills and climb the leaderboards in competitive PvP.

  • Duels and Open PK: Challenge others in one-on-one duels or engage in open player combat.

Forge Your Own Path:

Choose from 8 highly customizable character classes, each offering unique playstyles and abilities. Tailor your stats and skill progression to suit your strategy and preferences.

  • Full Character Customization: Personalize your character’s appearance with a wide variety of weapons and armor.

  • Dynamic Visuals: Your look evolves with every piece of equipment you wear.

  • Flexible Stat Allocation: Assign spirit points freely to shape your strengths.

  • Unique Specializations: Select from 8 distinct character specializations.

  • Versatile Skill Trees: Mix and match skills to create your perfect build.

Are you ready to write your legend in Kathana? The adventure awaits!

Recommended:

  • Processor: AMD Athlon 64 X2 Dual-Core 4000+ or better / Intel Core 2 Duo 2.0GHz or better
